answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network imposes superlinear stake burning per agent identity registered by a single cluster. Each participant submits a cryptographic cipher verifying unique hardware provenance before activation. As an attacker expands forged identities, required fee burns scale superlinearly like $C(n) \propto n^{2}$, hollowing out capital like acidic water eroding porous karst formations until costs reach a prohibitive zenith.
